scholarships.name: Freshman Scholarships
scholarships.description: Starting college straight from high school? You have unique funding opportunities waiting for you. Discover scholarships designed specifically for new students beginning their college journey. Explore Freshman Scholarships

scholarships.name: Transfer Scholarships
scholarships.description: Already started college somewhere else? Transfer students have special scholarship opportunities too. Find funding designed for students who are continuing their education at a new school. Explore Transfer Student Scholarships

scholarships.name: Scholarship Options
scholarships.description: Looking for additional ways to fund your education? Explore scholarships for continuing students, graduate programs, and specialized fields of study. Find more funding opportunities that might be the perfect fit for you. Explore Scholarship Options

scholarships.name: President's Scholarship
scholarships.description: The President's Scholarship is SEMO's most prestigious scholarship. No separate application is required.

scholarships.name: Will To Do Award
scholarships.description: The Will To Do Award ensures students will pay $0 out of pocket in tuition and general fees by covering any remaining amount after applying Pell, Access Missouri, institutional awards, and other tuition-specific grants/scholarships.

scholarships.name: Transfer Academic Scholarship
scholarships.description: Transfer academic scholarships are awarded at the time of admission to incoming transfer students who meet the eligibility requirements and apply to Southeast by the scholarship deadline. No separate application is required. These scholarships are only awarded before your first semester at Southeast

scholarships.name: Endowed and Sponsored Scholarships
scholarships.description: When an endowed scholarship is created, a donor gifts money to SEMO to start the scholarship fund to help you, our students, succeed. These donors can be alumni, businesses, community members, faculty/staff, or other individuals who want to help. SEMO awards nearly 2,000 endowed scholarships per yea

scholarships.name: Participation Scholarships
scholarships.description: If you are part of a particular academic department or group at SEMO, you may be eligible for a participation scholarship! scholarships.name: External Scholarships
scholarships.description: You don't have to stop at what SEMO offers you. There are many external scholarships for which you may qualify. We've made a list for you of trusted places to look and apply for more aid and to make your college education even more affordable. Explore Our List of External Scholarships
